Systeme.io has four plans based primarily on contact limits. Free: 2,000 contacts, 3 sales funnels, 1 course. Startup ($17/month): 5,000 contacts, 10 sales funnels, 5 courses. Webinar ($47/month): 10,000 contacts, 50 sales funnels, 20 courses, plus evergreen webinars. Unlimited ($97/month): unlimited contacts, funnels, courses and automation rules.

Does systeme.io have a free plan and what are its limits?
Yes, the free plan supports up to 2,000 contacts, 3 sales funnels, 1 blog, 1 course, 1 affiliate program, and 1 custom domain. Emails sent are unlimited. The free plan never expires and does not require a credit card. Other features have lower limits on the free plan, like 1 automation rule, 1 email campaign and 500 students. If you need more, the Startup plan at $17/month is the next step.

title: Free Plan Limits and Paid Plans
snippet:
Systeme.io pricing in 2026: a free plan for 2,000 contacts, then Startup $17, Webinar $47 and Unlimited $97 a month, or $170 to $970 a year.

Systeme.io is **free for up to 2,000 contacts**, then costs $17/mo for Startup, $47/mo for Webinar and $97/mo for Unlimited on monthly billing. Annual billing prints as $170, $470 and $970 a year, which Systeme.io sells as two months free. A custom Teams plan is quoted, and no plan charges a transaction fee.

| Plan | Monthly billing | Annual billing | Contacts | Funnels | Automation rules | Courses |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Free | $0 | $0 | 2,000 | 3 | 1 | 1 |
| Startup | $17/mo | $170/yr | 5,000 | 10 | 10 | 5 |
| Webinar | $47/mo | $470/yr | 10,000 | 50 | 100 | 20 |
| Unlimited | $97/mo | $970/yr | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| For teams | Custom | Custom | Everything in Unlimited | Plus a dedicated success manager | | |
Three things hold on every plan, free included. Emails sent are unlimited, file storage is unlimited, and the transaction fee is 0% on payments taken through Stripe or PayPal. The pricing page also lists unlimited sub-accounts on every plan, each with the same limits as the main account.

**Systeme.io is the cheapest of the three at every list size up to 10,000 contacts, and the only one with a free plan.**

| Need | Systeme.io | ClickFunnels | Kajabi |
|---|---|---|---|
| Entry plan, monthly | Startup $17: 5,000 contacts | Launch $97: 10K contacts, 50K emails a month | Basic $179: 2,500 contacts, 5 products |
| Entry plan, annual (per month) | $170 a year | $81/mo | $143/mo |
| About 10,000 contacts, monthly | Webinar $47 | Launch, same plan as above | Growth $249: 25,000 contacts |
| Free plan | Yes, 2,000 contacts | No | No |

Systeme.io answers part of that with unlimited assistant accounts on every plan and API access whose rate limit rises from 30 requests a minute on Free to unlimited on Unlimited.

Yes. The free plan never expires and needs no credit card. It includes up to 2,000 contacts, 3 funnels, 1 course with up to 500 students, unlimited emails and 0% transaction fees, but only 1 tag, 1 automation rule and 1 email campaign.
